title: kbmon and OpenTelemetry show the run states: spans, needs-you, landing queue, drift, worker trace context and alerts
goal: kbmon --events exports an item's run as a kb.item span with kb.worker and kb.landing children; the needs-you line names open asks to the operator and a blocked, failed or refused run with its gate or step; the coord panel shows the effective coordination settings with the file that set each; the sprint panel shows each open item's run state; kbmon shows the landing lock and its queue, which session waits on which items, and alerts while coord's run states drift from git; dispatch starts a worker with TRACEPARENT and OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES; Prometheus alerts on a waiting gate, a stalled run and a failed run, to a local Alertmanager
